svg.title: Parametric ghost rotated-ellipse wave — snap-dramatic-ease-in-out-moving
svg.desc: Dramatic clockwise blanket rotation without a static hold or zero-speed instant. A 20 percent linear velocity floor blended with a twice-composed C2 smootherstep keeps the blanket moving while making the symmetric middle transition 77 percent steeper over a 1.4 second visible loop. Every three blanket loops, the capsule eyes perform one fast blink along their fitted principal axes, remaining visible at 35 percent minimum aspect and reopening with an extreme ease-out and subtle overshoot.
